landing.does.title: It is built with food trucks in mind, not restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same working hours every week. But you work in a new place every week, at different times, where mobile network is weak or absent. HatchGrab was built for this.
landing.does.capacityBody: Decide how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and also on the card machine you take payment on now.
landing.does.postsTitle: Create your Facebook and Instagram posts automatically
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times; it becomes ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” While you drive to your selling spot or are at the stove, your WhatsApp messages get answered using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp messages will get answered while you drive to your selling spot or are at the stove. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the network drops, online ordering pauses automatically so customers do not place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Queues shrink, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Set up in about 15 minutes and start taking orders.
landing.steps.lede: There are three things to sort out — and two of them only need a photo.
landing.steps.menuBody: Take a photo of your board or paste the text. Items, prices and extras come in on their own. You only check they are right.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Is it on your website? We read it from there and keep it up to date. If not, take a photo of that too. You only approve what was found.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR code on the vehicle. Orders arrive on your screen in the order you need to cook them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made taking orders very easy for us. Everything is organised; we can track our stock and know exactly how many pizzas we have left to sell — and the time slots are wonderful for busy villages.
landing.testimonial.award: Best Mobile Pizzeria of the Year
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you need to.
landing.pricing.switchBody: See how much you would pay on HatchGrab for the same orders. It takes about a minute.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.metaDescription: Clear answers to the questions food truck owners ask: HatchGrab’s price, how to start, how to take orders, how the kitchen display and payments work — read before you register.
landing.final.title: Want to see how easy the setup is?
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu; in less than 60 seconds we turn it into a working ordering page for you to try. Your items, your prices. No registration, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, then decide.

featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the truck; payment is made on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen display (KDS), and also the only way to keep taking orders when the network drops.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff their own login with the appropriate access level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the network drops, online ordering pauses so customers do not place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you taking orders offline too; the web dashboard, though, needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals (combo) and offer extras at payment, to raise the average order size.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item “Sold out” in one touch — it fades for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count; it goes down as orders come in, then automatically becomes “Sold out”.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, give the order the buzzer number; that way you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety, in one place. We remind you before anything expires; and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one touch.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter how much each dish costs you; at every event see what you actually earned in profit, not just your takings.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone; you don’t need a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance via Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot; this spreads demand across your service.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Decide how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add a private event that does not show on the map; each has its own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one goes straight to the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, and nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You only review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Give WhatsApp auto-replies to questions asked about your menu and schedule.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Just as the WhatsApp auto-reply works, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers a text message (SMS) when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital stamp cards — collected automatically, redeemed automatically.

aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for mobile food services and food trucks: online ordering, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.title: Built around the way food trucks really work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with one simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I created a directory called Village Foodie, which helps people find food trucks visiting their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are always moving, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change this.
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for mobile food service providers and food trucks; we help them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and cut the time they spend answering repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier by offering tools designed around the way these businesses really work.
